title: Beranda Sekolah — pilih komposisi
question: The roll assigned Waktu Sekolah. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Waktu Sekolah
options.lineage: the school's own page of the day, framed by its own timezone
options.thesis: The page is headed by the one thing no two schools share — its own time — so the record reads as today's state, not a dashboard.
options.viewport: At 390px: bar, school name, the date in 20px with the zone in mono beneath it, then today's single honest line and one full-width green action.
options.risk: A date with no history behind it can read as decorative, and invites "why is this hardcoded?" — the timezone is per-tenant, the day is real, nothing else on the page is dated.

options.label: Kolom Ganda
options.thesis: Every fact the school can be held to sits in one hairline table, name left, number right, with nothing above the fold that is not a number.
options.viewport: At 390px: bar, a BUKU BESAR eyebrow, then four ruled rows — Akun, Aktif, Dinonaktifkan, Belum punya peran — the last in amber, and the action last so the numbers are seen first.
options.risk: Density is the whole argument and it is unforgiving: one wrong number or one unexplained word costs the page its authority, and the numbers say nothing about what to do next.

options.label: Rak Peran
options.lineage: the three school roles laid out as a shelf
options.thesis: The school's roles are the subject — Admin Sekolah, Guru, Staf/TU as three ruled rows — so a new admin learns the shape of their school before being asked to fill it.
options.viewport: At 390px: bar, a PERAN SEKOLAH eyebrow, one count line in 14px, then the three role names as 44px ruled rows each closing on the word "terdefinisi".
options.risk: The honest state word is identical on all three rows — the shelf proves the roles exist, never that anyone holds them, because per-role counts would need a second contract crossing.
